image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a black hockey puck resting on a neutral gray surface. The top face features a prominent white circular decal with a stylized mountain logo and text that appears to be gibberish or AI-generated artifacts rather than legible English. The side edge shows the characteristic ridges of a standard hockey puck.
